description: This file defines the ConnectionWatchdog class responsible for monitoring and managing the connection state within the application. It includes mechanisms to restart the connection after a delay and to listen for engine time updates to trigger reconnection behavior.

classes.name: ConnectionWatchdog
classes.description: Utility class to monitor and restart the connection based on engine time and timer events.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes monitoring by registering an EngineTimeListener and triggering an immediate data check.

methods.name: onDataArrived
methods.description: Resets the reconnect timer, causing an attempt to reconnect after the delay.
